The '''2.2 FD V-Tower''' was a model of anti-vehicle [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] that was manufactured by [[Atgar SpaceDefense Corporation/Legends|Atgar]]. It was crewed by four beings, but could be controlled from a command center if the crew was disabled. Several of them were deployed in defense of [[Fortress Keremark]].<ref name="HS" />
